chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 470 – The Mother Queens Watch & Yu Wei Faces Her Tribulation
chapter_meta_description: The Broken Horn World’s Mother Queens calmly observe Ji Ning from afar while Yu Wei begins her Heavenly Tribulation under Lu Dongbin’s worried gaze. A sealed void and an arriving army leave Ji Ning trapped.
og_title: Two Fronts of Tribulation: Observation and Desperation
og_description: The rulers of the Broken Horn World deploy a formation spanning tens of millions of li to trap Ji Ning, while Yu Wei’s Tribution proves far more terrifying than expected.
twitter_description: A formation bigger than a hundred commanderies locks Ji Ning down, and the Broken Horn World’s army arrives. Meanwhile, Yu Wei’s Tribulation alarms even Lu Dongbin.

lore_anchors.definition: The four-part ordeal (Wind, Fire, Thunder, Heartfiend) a cultivator must overcome to transcend mortality. The power scales based on the cultivator’s karma, past lives, and master’s tier.
A legendary figure in Daoist folklore and this novel, a reincarnated Lord of the East who is now a supreme Pure Yang True Immortal on the verge of Daofatherhood. He serves as Yu Wei’s master.
A powerful immortal realm; one step below Daofather. Lu Dongbin is considered the pinnacle of this stage in the Three Realms.
A divine archery art attributed to the mythical archer Houyi. Its arrows gain power over distance by absorbing ambient energy.
A divine ability that allows Ji Ning to see across vast distances and through various obstructions.
A movement technique that allows for rapid, long-distance flight with low divine power consumption once inertia is established.
The direct offspring of a Mother Queen in the Broken Horn World, possessing the greatest potential. The Mother Queens can perceive everything they experience.
The supreme progenitor and ruler(s) of the Broken Horn World, who gave birth to the entire civilization through a generation-hatching process.
